about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the 13th century - a time of rapid rise of the Mongol Empire and dramatic clashes between East and West. This visual novel transports you to the events of the first western campaign under the command of legendary generals Subedei and Jebe. Their journey across the steppes, the Caucasus, and Rus ends in a tragic clash on the Kalka River - a moment that changed history forever.

You will play as a hero who suddenly finds himself caught up in a whirlwind of intrigue, diplomacy, and brutal battles. Not only his fate, but the fate of entire nations will depend on your decisions.

Game features

• 🏹 Authentic historical basis — the plot is inspired by real events and chronicles of the 13th century: the first western campaign of the Mongol Empire, Subedei, Jebe, and the Battle of Kulka.

• 🗡 Branching storyline and moral choices — your decisions affect relationships with characters, political alliances, and the development of the story.

• 🌾 The atmosphere of the steppes and cultural clashes — feel the wind blowing across the endless expanses, learn about the traditions of nomads, and meet the druzhina of Rus.

• 🤝 Intrigue, diplomacy, and betrayal — from secret negotiations to unexpected alliances and deadly traps.

• 🎨 Detailed design — elaborate backgrounds, authentic costumes, and music inspired by nomadic peoples.

• 📜 History through the eyes of different peoples — you will see the events of the campaign not only through the eyes of a warrior, but also through the eyes of advisors, prisoners, and ordinary people.

• 🔄 Multiple endings — follow the chronicles or change the course of history.

content_descriptors.notes:
Contains combat with unrealistic injuries such as severed limbs, blood, and death.
Images and references to war, displacement, and slavery.

short_description: The first historical visual novel. 13th century - steppe, steel, and intrigue. Subedei and Jebe lead their armies westward, and it is up to you to decide: will history remain as written in the chronicles, or will you rewrite it anew?
supported_languages:
Russian*, English, Uzbek
*languages with full audio support
